Fiction project logline — The Relay Archive:
In the late 21st century, an atmospheric scavenger working the graveyard orbital belts discovers a cluster of obsolete 1970s telecommunication satellites whose magnetic core memory never degraded. When booted, they reveal accidental audio recordings of unencrypted civilian shortwave broadcasts from 1968, preserving conversations and musical performances erased from terrestrial history.
Key theme: physical obsolescence as unintended historical sanctuary.
